_description: ISCA'27 scale model s = 1/4 (user 10-26): overlay on mi200.json (or any config extending it) with the GPM shared resources scaled by 1/4 and the wafer network unchanged. Use after the mechanism config, e.g. -config m3p_r3real.json,mi200_quarter.json. See isca27/results_index/scalemodel/README.md.
_gpm-preset: mi200-quarter (gpm_preset.go): 8 CUs (4 SA x 2; 28/4 = 7 rounded up to whole 2-CU shader arrays), 2 L2 slices of 256 KiB (512 KiB) with 2 HBM2e channels; L2 TLB 8 sets x 16 ways, 8 MSHRs, 8 req/cycle; GMMU 4 walks in flight; -pm-adapt-track-cap, -pm-adapt-replica-budget-mb and -pm-l2-window are divided by 4 in the simulator. Per-CU resources, latencies, network, RDMA windows and the central IOMMU are those of mi200.
